title: Go/no-go before the peak freeze
context:
The release candidate includes **Apple Pay**, the **Reserve & Collect pilot** and several fixes. The **peak freeze starts tomorrow at 18:00**. Tom has finished regression: **142 tests, 139 passed, 3 failed**.

Priya: *"The promo fix is about 4 hours of development plus 2 hours re-running the promo regression. We can make it before the freeze if we start now."* Apple Pay is behind a **feature flag** that can be switched per brand and per operating-system version.

data.title: Failed regression tests
rows: Apple Pay sheet doesn't open on iOS 16 Safari
New feature; iOS 16 = 6% of iOS sessions; feature flag available
Expired promo code WINTER10 still accepted on Drogisterij Prijs
Regression in promo engine; estimated loss up to €2,500/day
Typo in Maison Parfum footer: "Privacy Polcy"

task: Classify each defect, make the go/no-go call, and write the go/no-go note.
constraints: Nothing can be released after the freeze until January
Be explicit about conditions and the rollback plan

parts.label: Classify the defects
parts.prompt: Choose the right handling for each defect.

explanations.d1: New feature for a small segment; switch the flag off for iOS 16 and keep it on elsewhere.
explanations.d2: It leaks money and it's a regression of an existing feature. It must be fixed (or the release stopped).
explanations.d3: Cosmetic, the link works. Fix in the next release.

options.label: Go as is
options.feedback: You would release a money-losing regression right before a long freeze.

options.label: No-go: postpone everything until January
options.feedback: Too cautious: the blocker is fixable before the freeze and the rest can be mitigated.

options.label: Go with conditions: fix and re-test D2 first, Apple Pay flag off for iOS 16, D3 later; no-go if the D2 fix misses the deadline
options.feedback: Balances value and risk, with a clear fallback.

options.label: Go, and switch off promotions on Drogisterij Prijs until January
options.feedback: Killing promotions in peak season costs far more than the fix.

parts.label: Go/no-go note
parts.prompt: Write the note to the stakeholders (decision, conditions, defects, rollback, monitoring).

keypoints.label: Promo fix plus re-test before release
Fallback if the fix misses the deadline

rubric.full: Money/legal first, segment + flag, cosmetic later
Go with conditions and a fallback
Decision first, then conditions, risks and plan

hints: For each defect ask: does it lose money or break the law? Is it new or a regression? Can it be switched off? How many shoppers?
There is a fix for the worst defect that fits before the freeze. What happens if it doesn't make it?

D1 mitigate (flag off for iOS 16), D2 blocker (fix + promo regression), D3 accept. Decision: go with conditions; no-go if D2 isn't fixed and re-tested by e.g. 15:00 tomorrow. Note: decision → conditions → defects → rollback trigger → monitoring → who's informed.
modelAnswer:
**Triage:** D1 → release with mitigation (flag off for iOS 16) · D2 → blocker · D3 → accept, fix in January.

**Call:** Go with conditions.

**Go/no-go note**
> **Decision: GO with conditions** for tomorrow's release.
> 1. **D2 (expired promo accepted on DP):** fix today, re-run the promo regression. If it isn't fixed and passed by **15:00 tomorrow**, it's a **no-go** for the whole release.
> 2. **D1 (Apple Pay on iOS 16):** Apple Pay goes live with the **flag switched off for iOS 16** (6% of iOS sessions). Fix planned for January.
> 3. **D3 (footer typo):** accepted, fixed in January.
>
> **Rollback:** if checkout conversion drops >10% for 30 minutes or payment errors exceed 2%, Priya and I decide on rolling back to the previous version (or flags off for Apple Pay / Reserve & Collect).
> **Monitoring:** checkout and payment dashboards watched for 2 hours after release; on-call developer named.
> **Informed:** BU managers of all three brands, customer service (promo code questions), store ops (Reserve & Collect pilot).
commonMistakes: Treating all three defects as blockers or all as acceptable
Forgetting the feature flag option for the new feature
No fallback if the blocker fix is late
